source_title: SCCM Clinical Practice Guidelines on Adult End-of-Life Care in the ICU
topic: Goals of care and adult ICU end-of-life context
clinical_context: Use when summarizing end-of-life communication context for clinician review.
key_points: The guideline states that multidisciplinary end-of-life care in the ICU is crucial.
It frames decision-making, conflict mitigation, suffering, and end-of-life capacity as important adult ICU care issues.
family_friendly_language: The team may ask what matters most to the patient so care discussions can reflect their values.
professional_preview_language: EOL context: consider documented goals, decision-maker, symptom burden, and conflict risk.
phrases_to_avoid: There is nothing left to do.
